title: Apple 1984 Super Bowl Commercial Introducing Macintosh Computer (HD)
summary: The famous 1984 Apple Macintosh Super Bowl commercial, directed by Ridley Scott and based on Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four. It casts the Mac as a force freeing individuals from a Big Brother figure, widely read as aimed at IBM.
why: Cited as the standard example of a hugely effective emotional ad that sold a brand image rather than product details.

quote.text: Apple's 1984 ad is still probably one of the most famous ads.
